purpose: One bounded zero-optimizer package to reproduce frozen scoring, preserve valid correspondence, measure attacks/sustain/silence, expose frozen head projections/state margins, and assess fixed neighboring-frame evidence without causal overclaim.
requiredEvidence: exact capture allowlist, performer/view, 200x192 shape, finite arrays, source/crop/target identities and zero unresolved labels
raw and identical boundary-corrected score paths with exclusion records
non-positional source-event correspondence with unmatched events retained
exact-center and fixed +/-2 attack probes kept separate
active non-attack sustain controls and silence controls
onset logits, w dot h, constant bias, and matched projected deltas
true-fret versus silence and strongest-incorrect state margins and admission outcomes
fixed adjacent-frame feature deltas as descriptive temporal evidence
explicit reproduction_failure, insufficient_correspondence and inconclusive outcomes
numericalReproducibility: If original prepared arrays are unavailable, numerical feature/logit equivalence remains explicitly unverified; equal aggregate metrics are not treated as numerical equivalence.
decisionPolicy: Observational geometry cannot prove a causal repair. A later fit, if justified, must be one separately frozen capped intervention with a predeclared split and comparator.

evidenceRetention.plan: Before execution, preserve authorized durable model/derived evidence and manifest hashes; never retrain merely to recreate an expired artifact.
